utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, I’m still set for 9 with the drill and socket set, and we’ll start on those loose fence panels.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Good to know. I’ll ask around quietly today and let Cleo know if anyone’s short on tarps, lumber, or basic tools.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good—if anyone comes up short on basic tools, I’ve got the drill and socket set covered when I get there at 9.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That helps a lot—Saturday 10 to 2, parking on Maple, and the drop-off by the entrance sounds manageable. I can mention it to a couple neighbors, but I’ll probably keep it low-key until I know how busy it gets.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: That all sounds fine, but can you confirm who’s actually committed to bring tools so we know it won’t be all talk?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I don’t know the tool list yet, and that’s exactly the kind of detail I’d want confirmed before I promise anyone much. I can ask Quinn who’s definitely bringing tools so we know how solid the setup is.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely, Noah—I’ve been telling people you’re helping with the repair drive, and if I hear the time again I’ll make sure to remind you.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Vik—I appreciate that. I’m in, I just keep losing track till the time’s pinned down.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: You got it, Noah—I’ll keep an ear out for the time and let folks know you’re still helping with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Mara, Faye can help with the repair drive as long as we avoid 8 to 9 and 2:30 to 3:30, so the middle of the day is our best bet.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That helps a lot — the porch repainting is Sunday after lunch, so that may fit Faye best. I’m checking the exact times with the organizer anyway, and I’ll confirm that along with how many volunteers are still needed.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect — if the porch repainting lands in that midday window, Faye should be a great fit. Let me know the confirmed time and volunteer count, and I’ll loop back with her.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: If you hear who’s short on lumber, tarps, or basic tools, send them my way and I’ll keep the list updated for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, I’ll pass along anything I hear—I'm getting there a bit late, but I can check the signup table first and help fill any gaps.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect—that’ll help a lot. If the table’s missing anything, especially lumber, tarps, or hand tools, tell me and I’ll add it to the list.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: From what I’ve heard, Mara’s firmly down for the socket set, and Ben’s confirmed the spare chains and pump too.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That sounds great — I can pitch in too, as long as it’s between 9 and 2:30 before school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That helps a lot, Faye — I’ll pass along that you’re good for the repair drive between 9 and 2:30, and right now Mara and Ben are the ones definitely confirmed with their gear.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: It’s set for 10 a.m. at the Maple garage. I’ll try to make it by.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Bo—10 at the Maple garage is right, and if you can swing by, we could still use hand tools, extension cords, or work gloves.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—I can probably bring gloves, and I’ll see if I can make it over by 10.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m in for the repair drive—tell me what needs fixing first, and I’ll pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Main jobs are the porch rails and the shed roof patch. I’m taking the rails Saturday morning, so if you can start on the shed roof, that’d help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good—I’ll start on the shed roof Saturday morning and bring my ladder and patch kit. If anything changes before then, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Nell, I’m spreading the word about the repair drive this Saturday from 10 to 2 at the community center—want to come by and maybe bring a neighbor too?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, good to know—it sounds like they’re still gathering things after all. I’d heard gloves and extension cords were useful, so I can probably bring some by and ask around too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’d be fantastic, Nell—parking’s easiest along Maple, and there’ll be a clearly marked drop-off table right by the community center entrance. If you can ask around too, I’d really love to get a good crowd there.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve got the repair drive logged for 10 a.m. at the community garage on Maple. If Bo changes anything, tell me and I’ll update it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good—let’s keep it straightforward: I’ll manage the signup sheet, and whoever’s on tools can handle check-in and patch kits so folks sign up first thing and we stay orderly.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect—I’ve still got it set for 10 a.m. at the community garage on Maple, and I’ll update the note if Bo shifts anything.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hana, can you confirm who’s covering paint and cleanup, and are you set to be there by 9 too?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I can’t confirm that yet—I’m still waiting on the organizer’s exact times and volunteer needs for the porch repainting and fence repair. Once Mara gets back to me, I’ll know whether 9 works and who’s covering paint and cleanup.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Okay—please check with Mara and text me as soon as you know. If paint and cleanup still aren’t covered, who can you ask next?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: We’ve still got the porch rails and the shed roof patch on the list, and Saturday morning would be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Saturday morning works for me—I’ll handle tool check-in and the patch kits, and Eli’s got the signup sheet so we keep the porch rails and shed roof orderly.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect—that keeps things tidy. Leo’s already taking the porch rails Saturday morning, so if you’ve got the patch kits covered, we can push the shed roof right after.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
